# Express Entry: points for a job offer
> MOCK FIXTURE — not real policy. For development only.

Arranged employment no longer earns Comprehensive Ranking System (CRS) points [1].
This change applies to all candidates in the pool as of 2025-03-25 [1].
A valid job offer may still help a candidate meet Federal Skilled Worker eligibility [2].
